$description: Round 13 STUDIO (Marcus's video comments, 22 Oct 2026): the pin's note in Check, the segmented control on Smoke glass and the staff campaign board's columns. All PROPOSED.

box-width.description: The note written beside a pin on a creative in Check (#51): a small Smoke glass box, like the customer's review viewer's.

track.description: A segmented control on Smoke glass (#66): the track is the clear veil, never the page's sunken white.

pill.description: The chosen option's pill on glass: Porcelain at 24 %, a clear step above the veil, never the 94 % white of the one main button on the glass.

fg.description: An option's words on glass: secondary Porcelain, weight 500.

fg-on.description: The chosen option's words on glass: Porcelain.

column.description: The narrowest column of the staff campaign board (#68): a stage (Brief … Delivery, then Done) with its campaigns as cards. Seven columns share the page's width and scroll sideways only when it is narrower than seven of these.
